blocks.text:
Breakfast. A scheduled group tour to the Argentine side of the falls. From the hotel, you will travel to the entrance of Iguazú National Park.

From the visitor centre, the ecological train travels through the Misiones jungle to Garganta del Diablo station. From here, a walking trail leads to the Devil's Throat, one of the most powerful cascades in the complex.

The tour then continues from Cataratas station: you can take the Upper Walk, approximately 500 m long, or the Lower Walk along a system of walkways. One shows the falls from above, while the other takes you closer to the lower cascades, offering changing views of the same waterfall complex.

Since December 2023, following exceptional flooding on the Iguazú River, the walkways to the Devil's Throat have been destroyed. The upper and lower walkways remain open, while access to the Devil's Throat is closed until further notice.

After the national park visit, discover the culture and history of yerba mate at the Yabuticaba Rainforest Market.

Return to the hotel after the programme.

blocks.text:
Breakfast. A scheduled group tour to the Brazilian side of the falls, travelling to Foz do Iguaçu National Park.

The main walking trail is approximately 950 m long and follows the banks of the Iguazú River. It offers a broad panorama of the cascades, so the Brazilian side complements the previous day's close-up views with an overall perspective of the falls. The tour ends at the Devil's Throat viewpoint. Return to the hotel after the visit.
